But specifically keeping this comment here in case of import, these parameters should be added to [[Template:infobox ancient site]] rather than deleted from this draft or article[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 02:02, 28 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{afc comment|1=I hope this is not too annoying but this article is gonna be placed under [[Category:Pages using infobox ancient site with unknown parameters]] and there is a decent chance these unknown parameters are ones I want added to the main template like burial chamber structure and burial goods. Please do not use any bots that just remove the unknown parameters without looking at them. This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox ancient site|type = [[Zenpokoenfun]] |name = Nishitonozuka Kofun |image = [[File:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, zenkei.jpg|280px]]
Full view of the mound (front section on the right, rear circle in the back left) | part_of = {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group|12=draft|12=draft}} (Nakayama subgroup) |location = {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市|12=draft|12=draft}}, Nakayama Town, Nishitonozuka{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}} |coordinates = 34|coordinates = 34|coordinates = 6.22 |coordinates = 135|coordinates = 51|coordinates = 4.26 |omitted = JP-29 |Type = {{ill|Keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft|12=draft}} |map_size = Mound length approximately 230{{ill|Meters|ja|メートル|12=draft|12=draft}}
Height approximately 16m (rear circle) |built = Late {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀|12=draft|12=draft}} to its end |burial = Unknown |Interred = ({{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁|12=draft|12=draft}} Historic Site) {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}
(One theory) {{ill|Queen Himiko|ja|台与|12=draft|12=draft}}
(Another theory) Emperor {{ill|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇|12=draft|12=draft}} |burial goods = {{ill|Special pedestal and pottery|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special plattypes and jars|12=draft|12=draft}}, Miyama-style special pedestals and pottery
Ordinary cylindrical haniwa |Mausoleum = {{ill|Fusumada Mausoleum|ja|衾田陵|12=draft|12=draft}} (Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency) |notes = Ranked 24th nationwide by size
(if mound length is considered 219m)[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/kanko/rekishi/dkofun/Ranking/zenkoku.html Ranking of Kofun areas in Japan] (Sakai City website, updated May 13, 2018).
Considered the royal tomb following {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} |map = Japan Nara |map_dot_label = Nishitonozuka Kofun |map_dot_label = Top |type = Keyhole-shaped tomb - South }} [[File:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, haisho.jpg|thumb|220px|{{center|{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}} Fusumada Mausoleum {{ill|Haisho|ja|拝所|lt=Worship Site|12=draft|12=draft}}}}]] '''Nishitonozuka Kofun''' (西殿塚古墳) is a {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} located in {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市|12=draft|12=draft}}, Nakayama Town. It is a {{ill|keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun|12=draft|12=draft}} and part of the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group|12=draft|12=draft}} (Nakayama subgroup). The identity of the interred is uncertain, but the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁|12=draft|12=draft}} designates the site as the '''Fusumada Mausoleum''' (衾田陵), the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}, the consort of [[Emperor Keitai]] It is estimated to have been built in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀|12=draft|12=draft}} (early {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代|12=draft|12=draft}}) and is considered the royal tomb succeeding the earliest keyhole-shaped tomb, the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}}. == Overview == It is a gigantic keyhole-shaped tumulus constructed on the hilly area along the eastern edge of the {{ill|Nara Basin|ja|奈良盆地|12=draft|12=draft}}. Adjacent to its eastern side is the {{ill|Higashitonotsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}}, and these two, being at the highest point within the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group|12=draft|12=draft}}, offer a panoramic view of the entire basinHistoric Site Explanation Board.{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. The tumulus has remained well preserved to the present day{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. It is currently managed by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁|12=draft|12=draft}} as the mausoleum of an empress under its jurisdiction; to date, exterior investigations of the tumulus have been conducted by the {{ill|Archives and Mausolea Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department|12=draft|12=draft}} during the {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成|12=draft|12=draft}} first fiscal year) period{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}, surveys of the surrounding area by the Tenri City Board of Education during the {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992nd year|12=draft|12=draft}}–{{ill|1994|ja|1994th year|12=draft|12=draft}} period (Heisei 4–6 fiscal years){{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}, and an academic on-site survey in the {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year|12=draft|12=draft}} period (Heisei 24 fiscal year){{R|2013rd year 調査}}. The tumulus is of a keyhole type with its anterior portion facing south; however, because it was constructed at a right angle to a sloping terrain (with the higher elevation on the east side), it takes on an asymmetrical type{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}. In the posterior circular portion, it is built with three tiers on the east side and four tiers on the west side, while in the anterior portion it is built with one tier on the east side and two tiers on the west side{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. The overall length of the tumulus measures about 230 {{ill|meters|ja|メートル|12=draft|12=draft}}, making it the largest within the Yamato Kofun Group. On its exterior, in addition to the presence of {{ill|Fukiishi|ja|葺石|12=draft|12=draft}}, early haniwa have been detected around the tumulus, including {{ill|Special plattypes and jars|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special Kiderai-type earthenware, special Kiderai-type haniwa, special tsubo-shaped haniwa|lt_ja=特殊器台形土器・特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪|12=draft|12=draft}} (from the tumulus itself) and {{ill|Cylindrical Haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|lt=cylindrical haniwa|12=draft|12=draft}} with a stepped neck{{R|説明板}}. Although the burial facilities remain unclear, square plattypes (mounds) are present on both the posterior and anterior portions of the tumulus{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. This Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to have been constructed in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀|12=draft|12=draft}} during the early part of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代|12=draft|12=draft}}{{R|説明板}}[http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html]{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} (Tenri City Homepage). It is regarded as the great tomb of the Yamato Kingdom that succeeded the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市|12=draft|12=draft}} Hashinaka){{R|白石}}, and in conjunction with the adjacent {{ill|Higaida-ōtsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}}, it is considered to be part of a continuous construction sequence beginning with Nishitonozuka Kofun{{R|説明板}}. Although the identity of the interred remains unclear, it is currently Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}} (the {{ill|Empress|ja|皇后|12=draft|12=draft}} of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇|12=draft|12=draft}} ){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. However, since the construction date does not correspond with the assumed period of the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀|12=draft|12=draft}} for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}, a theory that the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}} is the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} (in Tenri City, Kayashō Town) is strongly supported{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}, while alternative theories propose that the true interred of this tumulus is {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo|12=draft|12=draft}}, a successor to {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼|12=draft|12=draft}} (who may have been enshrined in the Hashihaka Kofun){{R|白石}}. == burial == The interred individual is not definitively known, but the site is officially Historic Site1 as the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}. However, the construction date (3rd century) conflicts with Princess Tashiraka’s presumed era (6th century), leading some to propose the nearby {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} as her true mausoleum.{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}} Other theories suggest Queen {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼|12=draft|12=draft}}’s successor, {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo|12=draft|12=draft}}, or [[Emperor Sujin]] as the interred individual.{{Sfn|白石太一郎|2013|pp=171-174}} == Site History == * {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era|12=draft|12=draft}} 9), Historic Site1 as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era|12=draft|12=draft}} 22), repaired and maintained as a mausoleum {{ill|Kinuta Tomb|ja|衾田陵（国史）|12=draft|12=draft}}. * {{ill|1986|ja|1986th year|12=draft|12=draft}} period ({{ill|Shōwa|ja|昭和|12=draft|12=draft}} 61 fiscal year), the first survey was conducted{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year|12=draft|12=draft}} period ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成|12=draft|12=draft}} first fiscal year), an exterior survey of the tumulus was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department|12=draft|12=draft}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. * From {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992|12=draft|12=draft}} to {{ill|1994|ja|1994th year|12=draft|12=draft}}, ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成|12=draft|12=draft}} 4–6 fiscal years), the 2nd to 4th surveys were conducted by the Tenri City Board of Education{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成|12=draft|12=draft}} 24): ** On April 9, an aerial 3D survey was conducted by the {{ill|Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute|ja|奈良県立橿原考古学研究所|12=draft|12=draft}} and {{ill|Asia Aerial Surveying|ja|アジア航測|12=draft|12=draft}}{{PDFlink|[http://www.ajiko.co.jp/news/2012/hashihaka_rittaichizu.pdf "Creation of a Red-colored 3D map of the Hashihaka and Seidenzuka Kofun"]}} (Press release from the Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute and Asia Aerial Surveying Co., Ltd., 2012).[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG0503K_V00C12A6CR8000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? 3D Helicopter Survey of the Hashihaka Kofun by Kashihara Institute, etc."] (Nikkei, June 5, 2012).. ** In August, following a theft incident (with no destruction of the remains) and subsequent restoration, a survey was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department|12=draft|12=draft}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|2013|ja|2013rd year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成|12=draft|12=draft}} 25) on February 20, an on-site survey was conducted by representatives of 15 academic societies in archaeology and history[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG1905C_Q3A220C1CR0000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? First On-site Survey at the Hashihaka Kofun in Nara, Raising Expectations for Research Progress"] (Nikkei, February 20, 2013).. == Kofun == [[File:Tonotono-tsuka stereo.jpg|thumb|{{center|Nishitonozuka Kofun's {{ill|Stereogram|ja|ステレオグラム|lt=Stereogram|lt_ja=ステレオ|12=draft|12=draft}} Aerial Photograph (1979) In the image, the {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} is shown at the top and the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} at the bottom. {{ill|National Aerial Photography|ja|国土航空写真|12=draft|12=draft}}.]] The area of the tumulus are as follows{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. * Kofun length: approximately 230 meters (in some sources, 234 meters{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}, 220 meters{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}, or 219 meters{{R|堺市}}). * Posterior circular portion – built with 3 tiers on the east side and 4 tiers on the west side. ** Diameter: approximately 140 meters ** Height: approximately 16 meters (east side) * Anterior portion – built with 1 tier on the east side and 2 tiers on the west side. ** Width: approximately 130 meters ** Height: approximately 12 meters (east side) * Square plattype (mound) – built in one tier. ** Posterior circular portion: 25.15 meters east–west, 26.54 meters north–south, height 3.00 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} ** Anterior portion: 12.92 meters east–west, 14.43 meters north–south, height 1.87 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} In the theory where the tumulus length is taken as 219 meters, it Ranks as the 24th largest in the country{{R|堺市}}. The tiered terraces of the tumulus do not directly connect the posterior circular and anterior portions; the difference in tiers between these portions is reconciled in the constricted section{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. Furthermore, on the western side of the tumulus, a broad, flat surface (apron), characteristic of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, has been shaped as the lowest tier{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. On the eastern side of the tumulus, there are two bridge-like structures located in the central area of the posterior circular portion and on the southern side of the anterior portion, both of which connect to the adjacent {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. == Interred ==
'''Family Tree Based on the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀|12=draft|12=draft}}'''The reign intypeation is based on the {{ill|Nihon Jinmei Daijiten|ja|日本人名大辞典|12=draft|12=draft}} (Kodansha). {{familytree/start|style="text-align:left; font-size:100%"}} {{familytree|border=0|||||01| 01={{sup|24}} {{ill|Emperor Ninken|ja|仁賢天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0|||||||)|.}} {{familytree|border=0|01|y|02|03| 01={{sup|26}} {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}
{{small|(Reign: 507?-531?)}}|02={{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}|03={{sup|25}} {{ill|Emperor Buretsu|ja|武烈天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century – early 6th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0||||01|| 01={{sup|29}} {{ill|Emperor Kinmei|ja|欽明天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}
{{small|(Reign: 539?-571?)}}}} {{familytree/end}}
The actual interred of the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} remains unclear; however, the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁|12=draft|12=draft}} designates it as the mausoleum of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}’s consort, '''{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}''' (Tashiraka no Hime-miko, also rendered as Tashiraka no Hairarō/ Tashiraka no Himemi){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}Compiled by the Imperial Ministry of Mausolea [{{NDLDC|1237123/11}} "Guide to Mausolea"] (1934, National Diet Library Digital Collection), 11 panels."Compilation of Mausoleum Topographical maps, Abbreviated Edition", compiled by the Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department Mausoleum Section, [[Gakuseisha]], 2014, p. 406.. Although the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}} is not mentioned in either the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀|12=draft|12=draft}} or the {{ill|Kojiki|ja|古事記|12=draft|12=draft}}, in the {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式|12=draft|12=draft}}’s mausolea section (displayed as {{ill|Shoryo Department|ja|諸陵寮|12=draft|12=draft}}) it is recorded as the distant "Kinuta Tomb". It is said to be located in {{ill|Yamato Province|ja|Yamato Province|12=draft|12=draft}}’s {{ill|Yamabe District|ja|山辺郡|12=draft|12=draft}}, covering an area of two chō east–west and two chō north–south, with no separate guard door, the mound door of the Kamikami Kofun of Yamabe (the mausoleum of {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}) concurrently serving as its guard{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. Later, during the {{ill|Medieval period|ja|中世|12=draft|12=draft}}, the traditional accounts regarding the location of the mausoleum were lost{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. In {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era|12=draft|12=draft}} 9), the {{ill|Kyōbushō|ja|教部省|1=Ministry of Religion (Japan)|lt=Ministry of Religion|qq= (Japan)|12=draft|12=draft}} Historic Site1 the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} as the mausoleum, and in {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year|12=draft|12=draft}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era|12=draft|12=draft}} 22) repairs were carried out{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. [[File:Hashihaka-kofun zenkei.JPG|サムネイル|220px|{{center|{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市|12=draft|12=draft}}, Hashinaka)}}{{small|Attributed to {{ill|Wajishiki no Hime|ja|倭迹迹日百襲姫命|12=draft|12=draft}}. Archaeologically, it is considered either the tomb of the first great king of the {{ill|Yamato Kingdom|ja|ヤマト王権|12=draft|12=draft}} or the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼|12=draft|12=draft}}.}}]] On the other hand, regarding the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}, a prevailing theory holds that it should be identified not with the Nishitonozuka Kofun but with the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} (located in Tenri City, Kayashō Town){{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. This theory is based on the fact that while the construction date of the Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to be around the latter half of the 3rd century, the date for the Nishiyamazuka Kofun is around the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀|12=draft|12=draft}}, which corresponds with the assumed period for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}}{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. Meanwhile, as for the true interred of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, some theories propose that it is {{ill|Daiyo|ja|台与|12=draft|12=draft}} (also written 壹與/臺與), based on its subsequent position to the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}}—regarded as the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼|12=draft|12=draft}}—or that it is {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇|12=draft|12=draft}}{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎|12=draft|12=draft}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'', Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 171-174.,{{ill|Suiz Wada|ja|和田萃|12=draft|12=draft}} “On the Yamabe Road”, in ''The Ancient History of Mount Miwa'', Gakuseisha, 2003. among others. {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%" |+ Estimated Early Great King Tombs of the Yamato Kingdom
{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎|12=draft|12=draft}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'' (日本歴史 私の最新講義), Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 181-186. ! Order !! Kofun name |- |1||{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} |- |2||'''{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}}''' |- |3||{{ill|Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|ja|桜井茶臼山古墳|lt=Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|lt_ja=外山茶臼山古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} |- |4||{{ill|Mesuriyama Kofun|ja|メスリ山古墳|12=draft|12=draft}} |- |5||{{ill|Andonyama Kofun|ja|行燈山古墳|1=Andon-yama Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} |- |6||{{ill|Shibuya Mukaeyama Kofun|ja|渋谷向山古墳|1=Shibutani Mukoyama Kofun|12=draft|12=draft}} |} == References == {{Reflist|2}} == Further Reading == * Site explanation board, Tenri City Board of Education, 2010. * {{Cite book|和書|title=Nishitonozuka Kofun and Higashitonozuka Kofun (Tenri City Historic Site Report No.7)|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2000|ref={{Harvid|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|title=100 Kofun in Tenri|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2015|ref={{Harvid|天理の古墳100|2015}}}} == Related Articles == * {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group|12=draft|12=draft}} * {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女|12=draft|12=draft}} == External Links == * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html Nishitonozuka Kofun - This was added through [[Special:MassEditRegex]] to all pages with the category so apologies if it was just some kind of an error like the image parameter being in Japanese[[User:Immanuelle|Immanuelle]] ([[User talk:Immanuelle|talk]]) 06:00, 27 March 2025 (UTC)}} {{Infobox ancient site|type = [[Zenpokoenfun]] |name = Nishitonozuka Kofun |image = [[File:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, zenkei.jpg|280px]]
Full view of the mound (front section on the right, rear circle in the back left) | part_of = {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} (Nakayama subgroup) |location = {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市}}, Nakayama Town, Nishitonozuka{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}} |coordinates = 34|coordinates = 34|coordinates = 6.22 |coordinates = 135|coordinates = 51|coordinates = 4.26 |omitted = JP-29 |Type = {{ill|Keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}} |map_size = Mound length approximately 230{{ill|Meters|ja|メートル}}
Height approximately 16m (rear circle) |built = Late {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} to its end |burial = Unknown |Interred = ({{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} Historic Site) {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}
(One theory) {{ill|Queen Himiko|ja|台与}}
(Another theory) Emperor {{ill|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇}} |burial goods = {{ill|Special pedestal and pottery|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special plattypes and jars}}, Miyama-style special pedestals and pottery
Ordinary cylindrical haniwa |Mausoleum = {{ill|Fusumada Mausoleum|ja|衾田陵}} (Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency) |notes = Ranked 24th nationwide by size
(if mound length is considered 219m)[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/kanko/rekishi/dkofun/Ranking/zenkoku.html Ranking of Kofun areas in Japan] (Sakai City website, updated May 13, 2018).
Considered the royal tomb following {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} |map = Japan Nara |map_dot_label = Nishitonozuka Kofun |map_dot_label = Top |type = Keyhole-shaped tomb - South }} [[File:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, haisho.jpg|thumb|220px|{{center|{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}} Fusumada Mausoleum {{ill|Haisho|ja|拝所|lt=Worship Site}}}}]] '''Nishitonozuka Kofun''' (西殿塚古墳) is a {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun}} located in {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市}}, Nakayama Town. It is a {{ill|keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}} and part of the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} (Nakayama subgroup). The identity of the interred is uncertain, but the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} designates the site as the '''Fusumada Mausoleum''' (衾田陵), the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}, the consort of [[Emperor Keitai]] It is estimated to have been built in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} (early {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}}) and is considered the royal tomb succeeding the earliest keyhole-shaped tomb, the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}}. == Overview == It is a gigantic keyhole-shaped tumulus constructed on the hilly area along the eastern edge of the {{ill|Nara Basin|ja|奈良盆地}}. Adjacent to its eastern side is the {{ill|Higashitonotsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}, and these two, being at the highest point within the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}}, offer a panoramic view of the entire basinHistoric Site Explanation Board.{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. The tumulus has remained well preserved to the present day{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. It is currently managed by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} as the mausoleum of an empress under its jurisdiction; to date, exterior investigations of the tumulus have been conducted by the {{ill|Archives and Mausolea Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} during the {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} first fiscal year) period{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}, surveys of the surrounding area by the Tenri City Board of Education during the {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992nd year}}–{{ill|1994|ja|1994th year}} period (Heisei 4–6 fiscal years){{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}, and an academic on-site survey in the {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year}} period (Heisei 24 fiscal year){{R|2013rd year 調査}}. The tumulus is of a keyhole type with its anterior portion facing south; however, because it was constructed at a right angle to a sloping terrain (with the higher elevation on the east side), it takes on an asymmetrical type{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}. In the posterior circular portion, it is built with three tiers on the east side and four tiers on the west side, while in the anterior portion it is built with one tier on the east side and two tiers on the west side{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. The overall length of the tumulus measures about 230 {{ill|meters|ja|メートル}}, making it the largest within the Yamato Kofun Group. On its exterior, in addition to the presence of {{ill|Fukiishi|ja|葺石}}, early haniwa have been detected around the tumulus, including {{ill|Special plattypes and jars|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special Kiderai-type earthenware, special Kiderai-type haniwa, special tsubo-shaped haniwa|lt_ja=特殊器台形土器・特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪}} (from the tumulus itself) and {{ill|Cylindrical Haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|lt=cylindrical haniwa}} with a stepped neck{{R|説明板}}. Although the burial facilities remain unclear, square plattypes (mounds) are present on both the posterior and anterior portions of the tumulus{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. This Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to have been constructed in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} during the early part of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}}{{R|説明板}}[http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html]{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} (Tenri City Homepage). It is regarded as the great tomb of the Yamato Kingdom that succeeded the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市}} Hashinaka){{R|白石}}, and in conjunction with the adjacent {{ill|Higaida-ōtsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}, it is considered to be part of a continuous construction sequence beginning with Nishitonozuka Kofun{{R|説明板}}. Although the identity of the interred remains unclear, it is currently Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} (the {{ill|Empress|ja|皇后}} of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}} ){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. However, since the construction date does not correspond with the assumed period of the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀}} for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}, a theory that the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} is the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} (in Tenri City, Kayashō Town) is strongly supported{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}, while alternative theories propose that the true interred of this tumulus is {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo}}, a successor to {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}} (who may have been enshrined in the Hashihaka Kofun){{R|白石}}. == burial == The interred individual is not definitively known, but the site is officially Historic Site1 as the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}. However, the construction date (3rd century) conflicts with Princess Tashiraka’s presumed era (6th century), leading some to propose the nearby {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} as her true mausoleum.{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}} Other theories suggest Queen {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}’s successor, {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo}}, or [[Emperor Sujin]] as the interred individual.{{Sfn|白石太一郎|2013|pp=171-174}} == Site History == * {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 9), Historic Site1 as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 22), repaired and maintained as a mausoleum {{ill|Kinuta Tomb|ja|衾田陵（国史）}}. * {{ill|1986|ja|1986th year}} period ({{ill|Shōwa|ja|昭和}} 61 fiscal year), the first survey was conducted{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year}} period ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} first fiscal year), an exterior survey of the tumulus was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. * From {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992}} to {{ill|1994|ja|1994th year}}, ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 4–6 fiscal years), the 2nd to 4th surveys were conducted by the Tenri City Board of Education{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 24): ** On April 9, an aerial 3D survey was conducted by the {{ill|Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute|ja|奈良県立橿原考古学研究所}} and {{ill|Asia Aerial Surveying|ja|アジア航測}}{{PDFlink|[http://www.ajiko.co.jp/news/2012/hashihaka_rittaichizu.pdf "Creation of a Red-colored 3D map of the Hashihaka and Seidenzuka Kofun"]}} (Press release from the Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute and Asia Aerial Surveying Co., Ltd., 2012).[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG0503K_V00C12A6CR8000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? 3D Helicopter Survey of the Hashihaka Kofun by Kashihara Institute, etc."] (Nikkei, June 5, 2012).. ** In August, following a theft incident (with no destruction of the remains) and subsequent restoration, a survey was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|2013|ja|2013rd year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 25) on February 20, an on-site survey was conducted by representatives of 15 academic societies in archaeology and history[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG1905C_Q3A220C1CR0000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? First On-site Survey at the Hashihaka Kofun in Nara, Raising Expectations for Research Progress"] (Nikkei, February 20, 2013).. == Kofun == [[File:Tonotono-tsuka stereo.jpg|thumb|{{center|Nishitonozuka Kofun's {{ill|Stereogram|ja|ステレオグラム|lt=Stereogram|lt_ja=ステレオ}} Aerial Photograph (1979) In the image, the {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}} is shown at the top and the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} at the bottom. {{ill|National Aerial Photography|ja|国土航空写真}}.]] The area of the tumulus are as follows{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. * Kofun length: approximately 230 meters (in some sources, 234 meters{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}, 220 meters{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}, or 219 meters{{R|堺市}}). * Posterior circular portion – built with 3 tiers on the east side and 4 tiers on the west side. ** Diameter: approximately 140 meters ** Height: approximately 16 meters (east side) * Anterior portion – built with 1 tier on the east side and 2 tiers on the west side. ** Width: approximately 130 meters ** Height: approximately 12 meters (east side) * Square plattype (mound) – built in one tier. ** Posterior circular portion: 25.15 meters east–west, 26.54 meters north–south, height 3.00 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} ** Anterior portion: 12.92 meters east–west, 14.43 meters north–south, height 1.87 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} In the theory where the tumulus length is taken as 219 meters, it Ranks as the 24th largest in the country{{R|堺市}}. The tiered terraces of the tumulus do not directly connect the posterior circular and anterior portions; the difference in tiers between these portions is reconciled in the constricted section{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. Furthermore, on the western side of the tumulus, a broad, flat surface (apron), characteristic of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, has been shaped as the lowest tier{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. On the eastern side of the tumulus, there are two bridge-like structures located in the central area of the posterior circular portion and on the southern side of the anterior portion, both of which connect to the adjacent {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. == Interred ==
'''Family Tree Based on the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀}}'''The reign intypeation is based on the {{ill|Nihon Jinmei Daijiten|ja|日本人名大辞典}} (Kodansha). {{familytree/start|style="text-align:left; font-size:100%"}} {{familytree|border=0|||||01| 01={{sup|24}} {{ill|Emperor Ninken|ja|仁賢天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0|||||||)|.}} {{familytree|border=0|01|y|02|03| 01={{sup|26}} {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: 507?-531?)}}|02={{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}|03={{sup|25}} {{ill|Emperor Buretsu|ja|武烈天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century – early 6th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0||||01|| 01={{sup|29}} {{ill|Emperor Kinmei|ja|欽明天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: 539?-571?)}}}} {{familytree/end}}
The actual interred of the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} remains unclear; however, the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} designates it as the mausoleum of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}}’s consort, '''{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}''' (Tashiraka no Hime-miko, also rendered as Tashiraka no Hairarō/ Tashiraka no Himemi){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}Compiled by the Imperial Ministry of Mausolea [{{NDLDC|1237123/11}} "Guide to Mausolea"] (1934, National Diet Library Digital Collection), 11 panels."Compilation of Mausoleum Topographical maps, Abbreviated Edition", compiled by the Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department Mausoleum Section, [[Gakuseisha]], 2014, p. 406.. Although the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} is not mentioned in either the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀}} or the {{ill|Kojiki|ja|古事記}}, in the {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式}}’s mausolea section (displayed as {{ill|Shoryo Department|ja|諸陵寮}}) it is recorded as the distant "Kinuta Tomb". It is said to be located in {{ill|Yamato Province|ja|Yamato Province}}’s {{ill|Yamabe District|ja|山辺郡}}, covering an area of two chō east–west and two chō north–south, with no separate guard door, the mound door of the Kamikami Kofun of Yamabe (the mausoleum of {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇}}) concurrently serving as its guard{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. Later, during the {{ill|Medieval period|ja|中世}}, the traditional accounts regarding the location of the mausoleum were lost{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. In {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 9), the {{ill|Kyōbushō|ja|教部省|1=Ministry of Religion (Japan)|lt=Ministry of Religion|qq= (Japan)}} Historic Site1 the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} as the mausoleum, and in {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 22) repairs were carried out{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. [[File:Hashihaka-kofun zenkei.JPG|サムネイル|220px|{{center|{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市}}, Hashinaka)}}{{small|Attributed to {{ill|Wajishiki no Hime|ja|倭迹迹日百襲姫命}}. Archaeologically, it is considered either the tomb of the first great king of the {{ill|Yamato Kingdom|ja|ヤマト王権}} or the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}.}}]] On the other hand, regarding the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}, a prevailing theory holds that it should be identified not with the Nishitonozuka Kofun but with the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} (located in Tenri City, Kayashō Town){{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. This theory is based on the fact that while the construction date of the Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to be around the latter half of the 3rd century, the date for the Nishiyamazuka Kofun is around the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀}}, which corresponds with the assumed period for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. Meanwhile, as for the true interred of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, some theories propose that it is {{ill|Daiyo|ja|台与}} (also written 壹與/臺與), based on its subsequent position to the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}}—regarded as the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}—or that it is {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇}}{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'', Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 171-174.,{{ill|Suiz Wada|ja|和田萃}} “On the Yamabe Road”, in ''The Ancient History of Mount Miwa'', Gakuseisha, 2003. among others. {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%" |+ Estimated Early Great King Tombs of the Yamato Kingdom
{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'' (日本歴史 私の最新講義), Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 181-186. ! Order !! Kofun name |- |1||{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} |- |2||'''{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}}''' |- |3||{{ill|Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|ja|桜井茶臼山古墳|lt=Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|lt_ja=外山茶臼山古墳}} |- |4||{{ill|Mesuriyama Kofun|ja|メスリ山古墳}} |- |5||{{ill|Andonyama Kofun|ja|行燈山古墳|1=Andon-yama Kofun}} |- |6||{{ill|Shibuya Mukaeyama Kofun|ja|渋谷向山古墳|1=Shibutani Mukoyama Kofun}} |} == References == {{Reflist|2}} == Further Reading == * Site explanation board, Tenri City Board of Education, 2010. * {{Cite book|和書|title=Nishitonozuka Kofun and Higashitonozuka Kofun (Tenri City Historic Site Report No.7)|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2000|ref={{Harvid|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|title=100 Kofun in Tenri|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2015|ref={{Harvid|天理の古墳100|2015}}}} == Related Articles == * {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} * {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}} == External Links == * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html Nishitonozuka Kofun - Full view of the mound (front section on the right, rear circle in the back left) | part_of = {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} (Nakayama subgroup) |location = {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市}}, Nakayama Town, Nishitonozuka{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}} |coordinates = 34|coordinates = 34|coordinates = 6.22 |coordinates = 135|coordinates = 51|coordinates = 4.26 |omitted = JP-29 |Type = {{ill|Keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}} |map_size = Mound length approximately 230{{ill|Meters|ja|メートル}}
Height approximately 16m (rear circle) |built = Late {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} to its end |burial = Unknown |Interred = ({{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} Historic Site) {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}

(Another theory) Emperor {{ill|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇}} |burial goods = {{ill|Special pedestal and pottery|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special plattypes and jars}}, Miyama-style special pedestals and pottery
Ordinary cylindrical haniwa |Mausoleum = {{ill|Fusumada Mausoleum|ja|衾田陵}} (Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency) |notes = Ranked 24th nationwide by size
(if mound length is considered 219m)[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/kanko/rekishi/dkofun/Ranking/zenkoku.html Ranking of Kofun areas in Japan] (Sakai City website, updated May 13, 2018).
Considered the royal tomb following {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} |map = Japan Nara |map_dot_label = Nishitonozuka Kofun |map_dot_label = Top |type = Keyhole-shaped tomb - South }} [[File:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, haisho.jpg|thumb|220px|{{center|{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}} Fusumada Mausoleum {{ill|Haisho|ja|拝所|lt=Worship Site}}}}]] '''Nishitonozuka Kofun''' (西殿塚古墳) is a {{ill|kofun|ja|古墳|1=Kofun}} located in {{ill|Tenri, Nara Prefecture|ja|天理市}}, Nakayama Town. It is a {{ill|keyhole-shaped tumulus|ja|前方後円墳|1=Zenpokoenfun|1=Zenpokoenfun}} and part of the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} (Nakayama subgroup). The identity of the interred is uncertain, but the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} designates the site as the '''Fusumada Mausoleum''' (衾田陵), the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}, the consort of [[Emperor Keitai]] It is estimated to have been built in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} (early {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}}) and is considered the royal tomb succeeding the earliest keyhole-shaped tomb, the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}}. == Overview == It is a gigantic keyhole-shaped tumulus constructed on the hilly area along the eastern edge of the {{ill|Nara Basin|ja|奈良盆地}}. Adjacent to its eastern side is the {{ill|Higashitonotsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}, and these two, being at the highest point within the {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}}, offer a panoramic view of the entire basinHistoric Site Explanation Board.{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. The tumulus has remained well preserved to the present day{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. It is currently managed by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} as the mausoleum of an empress under its jurisdiction; to date, exterior investigations of the tumulus have been conducted by the {{ill|Archives and Mausolea Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} during the {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} first fiscal year) period{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}, surveys of the surrounding area by the Tenri City Board of Education during the {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992nd year}}–{{ill|1994|ja|1994th year}} period (Heisei 4–6 fiscal years){{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}, and an academic on-site survey in the {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year}} period (Heisei 24 fiscal year){{R|2013rd year 調査}}. The tumulus is of a keyhole type with its anterior portion facing south; however, because it was constructed at a right angle to a sloping terrain (with the higher elevation on the east side), it takes on an asymmetrical type{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}. In the posterior circular portion, it is built with three tiers on the east side and four tiers on the west side, while in the anterior portion it is built with one tier on the east side and two tiers on the west side{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. The overall length of the tumulus measures about 230 {{ill|meters|ja|メートル}}, making it the largest within the Yamato Kofun Group. On its exterior, in addition to the presence of {{ill|Fukiishi|ja|葺石}}, early haniwa have been detected around the tumulus, including {{ill|Special plattypes and jars|ja|特殊器台・特殊壺|1=Special platforms and jars|1=Special platforms and jars|lt=Special Kiderai-type earthenware, special Kiderai-type haniwa, special tsubo-shaped haniwa|lt_ja=特殊器台形土器・特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪}} (from the tumulus itself) and {{ill|Cylindrical Haniwa|ja|円筒埴輪|lt=cylindrical haniwa}} with a stepped neck{{R|説明板}}. Although the burial facilities remain unclear, square plattypes (mounds) are present on both the posterior and anterior portions of the tumulus{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. This Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to have been constructed in the latter half of the {{ill|3rd century|ja|3世紀}} during the early part of the {{ill|Kofun period|ja|古墳時代}}{{R|説明板}}[http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html]{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} (Tenri City Homepage). It is regarded as the great tomb of the Yamato Kingdom that succeeded the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市}} Hashinaka){{R|白石}}, and in conjunction with the adjacent {{ill|Higaida-ōtsuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}, it is considered to be part of a continuous construction sequence beginning with Nishitonozuka Kofun{{R|説明板}}. Although the identity of the interred remains unclear, it is currently Historic Site1 by the Imperial Household Agency as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} (the {{ill|Empress|ja|皇后}} of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}} ){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. However, since the construction date does not correspond with the assumed period of the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀}} for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}, a theory that the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} is the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} (in Tenri City, Kayashō Town) is strongly supported{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}, while alternative theories propose that the true interred of this tumulus is {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo}}, a successor to {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}} (who may have been enshrined in the Hashihaka Kofun){{R|白石}}. == burial == The interred individual is not definitively known, but the site is officially Historic Site1 as the resting place of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}}. However, the construction date (3rd century) conflicts with Princess Tashiraka’s presumed era (6th century), leading some to propose the nearby {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} as her true mausoleum.{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}} Other theories suggest Queen {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}’s successor, {{ill|Toyo (queen)|ja|台与|lt=Queen Toyo}}, or [[Emperor Sujin]] as the interred individual.{{Sfn|白石太一郎|2013|pp=171-174}} == Site History == * {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 9), Historic Site1 as the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 22), repaired and maintained as a mausoleum {{ill|Kinuta Tomb|ja|衾田陵（国史）}}. * {{ill|1986|ja|1986th year}} period ({{ill|Shōwa|ja|昭和}} 61 fiscal year), the first survey was conducted{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|1989|ja|1989th year}} period ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} first fiscal year), an exterior survey of the tumulus was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. * From {{ill|1992|ja|1992nd year |lt=1992|lt_ja=1992}} to {{ill|1994|ja|1994th year}}, ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 4–6 fiscal years), the 2nd to 4th surveys were conducted by the Tenri City Board of Education{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}. * {{ill|2012|ja|2012nd year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 24): ** On April 9, an aerial 3D survey was conducted by the {{ill|Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute|ja|奈良県立橿原考古学研究所}} and {{ill|Asia Aerial Surveying|ja|アジア航測}}{{PDFlink|[http://www.ajiko.co.jp/news/2012/hashihaka_rittaichizu.pdf "Creation of a Red-colored 3D map of the Hashihaka and Seidenzuka Kofun"]}} (Press release from the Nara Prefectural Kashihara Archaeological Institute and Asia Aerial Surveying Co., Ltd., 2012).[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG0503K_V00C12A6CR8000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? 3D Helicopter Survey of the Hashihaka Kofun by Kashihara Institute, etc."] (Nikkei, June 5, 2012).. ** In August, following a theft incident (with no destruction of the remains) and subsequent restoration, a survey was carried out by the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department|ja|宮内庁書陵部|1=Archives and Mausolea Department}} {{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}. * {{ill|2013|ja|2013rd year}} ({{ill|Heisei|ja|平成}} 25) on February 20, an on-site survey was conducted by representatives of 15 academic societies in archaeology and history[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG1905C_Q3A220C1CR0000/ "Himiko’s Tomb? First On-site Survey at the Hashihaka Kofun in Nara, Raising Expectations for Research Progress"] (Nikkei, February 20, 2013).. == Kofun == [[File:Tonotono-tsuka stereo.jpg|thumb|{{center|Nishitonozuka Kofun's {{ill|Stereogram|ja|ステレオグラム|lt=Stereogram|lt_ja=ステレオ}} Aerial Photograph (1979) In the image, the {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}} is shown at the top and the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} at the bottom. {{ill|National Aerial Photography|ja|国土航空写真}}.]] The area of the tumulus are as follows{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. * Kofun length: approximately 230 meters (in some sources, 234 meters{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳（古墳）|1989}}, 220 meters{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}, or 219 meters{{R|堺市}}). * Posterior circular portion – built with 3 tiers on the east side and 4 tiers on the west side. ** Diameter: approximately 140 meters ** Height: approximately 16 meters (east side) * Anterior portion – built with 1 tier on the east side and 2 tiers on the west side. ** Width: approximately 130 meters ** Height: approximately 12 meters (east side) * Square plattype (mound) – built in one tier. ** Posterior circular portion: 25.15 meters east–west, 26.54 meters north–south, height 3.00 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} ** Anterior portion: 12.92 meters east–west, 14.43 meters north–south, height 1.87 meters{{R|2012nd year 報道発表資料}} In the theory where the tumulus length is taken as 219 meters, it Ranks as the 24th largest in the country{{R|堺市}}. The tiered terraces of the tumulus do not directly connect the posterior circular and anterior portions; the difference in tiers between these portions is reconciled in the constricted section{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}. Furthermore, on the western side of the tumulus, a broad, flat surface (apron), characteristic of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, has been shaped as the lowest tier{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. On the eastern side of the tumulus, there are two bridge-like structures located in the central area of the posterior circular portion and on the southern side of the anterior portion, both of which connect to the adjacent {{ill|Higashidenzuka Kofun|ja|東殿塚古墳|1=Higashitonotsuka Kofun}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}. == Interred ==
'''Family Tree Based on the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀}}'''The reign intypeation is based on the {{ill|Nihon Jinmei Daijiten|ja|日本人名大辞典}} (Kodansha). {{familytree/start|style="text-align:left; font-size:100%"}} {{familytree|border=0|||||01| 01={{sup|24}} {{ill|Emperor Ninken|ja|仁賢天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0|||||||)|.}} {{familytree|border=0|01|y|02|03| 01={{sup|26}} {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: 507?-531?)}}|02={{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}|03={{sup|25}} {{ill|Emperor Buretsu|ja|武烈天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: end of 5th century – early 6th century)}}}} {{familytree|border=0||||01|| 01={{sup|29}} {{ill|Emperor Kinmei|ja|欽明天皇}}
{{small|(Reign: 539?-571?)}}}} {{familytree/end}}
The actual interred of the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} remains unclear; however, the {{ill|Imperial Household Agency|ja|宮内庁}} designates it as the mausoleum of the 26th {{ill|Emperor Keitai|ja|継体天皇}}’s consort, '''{{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}''' (Tashiraka no Hime-miko, also rendered as Tashiraka no Hairarō/ Tashiraka no Himemi){{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}Compiled by the Imperial Ministry of Mausolea [{{NDLDC|1237123/11}} "Guide to Mausolea"] (1934, National Diet Library Digital Collection), 11 panels."Compilation of Mausoleum Topographical maps, Abbreviated Edition", compiled by the Imperial Household Agency Shoryo Department Mausoleum Section, [[Gakuseisha]], 2014, p. 406.. Although the mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}} is not mentioned in either the {{ill|Nihon Shoki|ja|日本書紀}} or the {{ill|Kojiki|ja|古事記}}, in the {{ill|Engishiki|ja|延喜式}}’s mausolea section (displayed as {{ill|Shoryo Department|ja|諸陵寮}}) it is recorded as the distant "Kinuta Tomb". It is said to be located in {{ill|Yamato Province|ja|Yamato Province}}’s {{ill|Yamabe District|ja|山辺郡}}, covering an area of two chō east–west and two chō north–south, with no separate guard door, the mound door of the Kamikami Kofun of Yamabe (the mausoleum of {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇}}) concurrently serving as its guard{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. Later, during the {{ill|Medieval period|ja|中世}}, the traditional accounts regarding the location of the mausoleum were lost{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. In {{ill|1876|ja|1876th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 9), the {{ill|Kyōbushō|ja|教部省|1=Ministry of Religion (Japan)|lt=Ministry of Religion|qq= (Japan)}} Historic Site1 the {{ill|Seidenzuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}} as the mausoleum, and in {{ill|1889|ja|1889th year}} ({{ill|Meiji|ja|明治|1=Meiji era}} 22) repairs were carried out{{Sfn|衾田陵（国史）}}. [[File:Hashihaka-kofun zenkei.JPG|サムネイル|220px|{{center|{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} (located in {{ill|Sakurai City|ja|桜井市}}, Hashinaka)}}{{small|Attributed to {{ill|Wajishiki no Hime|ja|倭迹迹日百襲姫命}}. Archaeologically, it is considered either the tomb of the first great king of the {{ill|Yamato Kingdom|ja|ヤマト王権}} or the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}.}}]] On the other hand, regarding the true mausoleum of {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}, a prevailing theory holds that it should be identified not with the Nishitonozuka Kofun but with the {{ill|Nishiyamazuka Kofun|ja|西山塚古墳}} (located in Tenri City, Kayashō Town){{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. This theory is based on the fact that while the construction date of the Nishitonozuka Kofun is estimated to be around the latter half of the 3rd century, the date for the Nishiyamazuka Kofun is around the {{ill|6th century|ja|6世紀}}, which corresponds with the assumed period for {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|lt=Tebarakakōjo|ja|手白香皇女}}{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}. Meanwhile, as for the true interred of the Nishitonozuka Kofun, some theories propose that it is {{ill|Daiyo|ja|台与}} (also written 壹與/臺與), based on its subsequent position to the {{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}}—regarded as the tomb of {{ill|Himiko|ja|卑弥呼}}—or that it is {{ill|Emperor Sushin|ja|崇神天皇}}{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'', Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 171-174.,{{ill|Suiz Wada|ja|和田萃}} “On the Yamabe Road”, in ''The Ancient History of Mount Miwa'', Gakuseisha, 2003. among others. {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%" |+ Estimated Early Great King Tombs of the Yamato Kingdom
{{ill|Taichirō Shiraishi|ja|白石太一郎}}, ''The Formation and Development of the Wa Kingdom as Seen from the Kofun'' (日本歴史 私の最新講義), Keibunsha, 2013, pp. 181-186. ! Order !! Kofun name |- |1||{{ill|Hashihaka Kofun|ja|箸墓古墳}} |- |2||'''{{ill|Nishitonozuka Kofun|ja|西殿塚古墳|1=Nishitonozuka Kofun}}''' |- |3||{{ill|Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|ja|桜井茶臼山古墳|lt=Sakurai Chausuyama Kofun|lt_ja=外山茶臼山古墳}} |- |4||{{ill|Mesuriyama Kofun|ja|メスリ山古墳}} |- |5||{{ill|Andonyama Kofun|ja|行燈山古墳|1=Andon-yama Kofun}} |- |6||{{ill|Shibuya Mukaeyama Kofun|ja|渋谷向山古墳|1=Shibutani Mukoyama Kofun}} |} == References == {{Reflist|2}} == Further Reading == * Site explanation board, Tenri City Board of Education, 2010. * {{Cite book|和書|title=Nishitonozuka Kofun and Higashitonozuka Kofun (Tenri City Historic Site Report No.7)|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2000|ref={{Harvid|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000}}}} * {{Cite book|和書|title=100 Kofun in Tenri|publisher=Tenri City Board of Education|year=2015|ref={{Harvid|天理の古墳100|2015}}}} == Related Articles == * {{ill|Yamato Kofun Group|ja|大和古墳群|1=Ōyamato Kofun Group}} * {{ill|Princess Tashiraka|ja|手白香皇女}} == External Links == * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html Nishitonozuka Kofun - revision.text:
{{日本の古墳 |名称 = 西殿塚古墳 |画像 = [[画像:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, zenkei.jpg|280px]]
墳丘（右に前方部、左奥に後円部） |所属 = [[大和古墳群]]（中山支群） |所在地 = [[奈良県]][[天理市]]中山町字西殿塚{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}} |緯度度 = 34|緯度分 = 34|緯度秒 = 6.22 |経度度 =135|経度分 = 51|経度秒 = 4.26 |ISO = JP-29 |形状 = [[前方後円墳]] |規模 = 墳丘長230[[メートル|m]]
高さ約16m（後円部） |築造時期 = [[3世紀]]後半-末 |埋葬施設 = 不明 |被葬者 = （[[宮内庁]]治定）[[手白香皇女]]
（一説）[[台与|倭王台与]]
（一説）第10代[[崇神天皇]] |出土品 = [[特殊器台・特殊壺|宮山型特殊器台・特殊壺・都月型特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪]]
[[円筒埴輪|普通円筒埴輪]] |陵墓 = [[宮内庁]]治定「衾田陵」 |特記事項 = 全国第24位の規模
（墳丘長219mとする場合）[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/kanko/rekishi/dkofun/ranking/zenkoku.html 古墳大きさランキング（日本全国版）]（堺市ホームページ、2018年5月13日更新版）。
[[箸墓古墳]]に次ぐ大王墓か |地図 = Japan Nara |ラベル = 西殿塚古墳 |ラベル位置 = top |アイコン = 前方後円墳-南 }} [[画像:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, haisho.jpg|サムネイル|250px|{{center|[[手白香皇女]]衾田陵 拝所}}]] '''西殿塚古墳'''（にしとのづかこふん{{R|説明板}}）は、[[奈良県]][[天理市]]中山町にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[前方後円墳]]。[[大和古墳群]]（中山支群）を構成する古墳の1つ。 実際の被葬者は明らかでないが、[[宮内庁]]により「'''衾田陵'''（ふすまだのみささぎ）」として第26代[[継体天皇]]皇后の[[手白香皇女]]の陵に治定されている。 [[3世紀]]後半（[[古墳時代]]前期前半）頃の築造と推定され、古墳時代最初期の[[箸墓古墳]]に後続する大王墓とする説で知られる。 == 概要 == [[奈良盆地]]東縁の丘陵上に築造された巨大前方後円墳である。東側には隣接して[[東殿塚古墳]]があり、2基は[[大和古墳群]]のうちでは最高所にあって盆地全域を眺望する史跡説明板。{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。墳丘は良好に遺存する{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。現在は[[宮内庁]]治定の皇后陵として同庁の管理下にあり、[[1989年]]度（[[平成]]元年度）に[[宮内庁書陵部]]による墳丘外表調査が実施されたほか{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}、[[1992年|1992]]-[[1994年]]度（平成4-6年度）に天理市教育委員会による墳丘周辺部の調査{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}、[[2012年]]度（平成24年度）に学会立ち入り調査などが実施されている{{R|2013年調査}}。 墳形は前方後円形で前方部を南方に向けるが、東西方向の傾斜地（高位は東側）に直角に築造されているため左右非対称形をとる{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}。墳丘は後円部で東側3段築成・西側4段築成、前方部で東側1段築成・西側2段築成{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。墳丘長は約230[[メートル]]を測るが、これは大和古墳群では最大規模になる。墳丘外表には[[葺石]]が認められるほか{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}、[[特殊器台・特殊壺|特殊器台形土器・特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪]]（以上墳丘部）、有段口縁の[[円筒埴輪]]などの初期埴輪（墳丘周辺部）等が出土している{{R|説明板}}。埋葬施設は明らかでないが、墳丘上では後円部・前方部それぞれに方形壇（方丘）が認められている{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 築造時期は、[[古墳時代]]前期前半の[[3世紀]]後半頃と推定される{{R|説明板}}[http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html 西殿塚古墳]（天理市ホームページ）。。[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）に後続する[[ヤマト王権]]の大王墓と目され{{R|白石}}、隣接する東殿塚古墳とでは西殿塚古墳を先とする連続的な築造とされる{{R|説明板}}。被葬者は明らかでないが、現在は宮内庁により[[手白香皇女]]（第26代[[継体天皇]][[皇后]]）の陵に治定される{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。ただし築造年代は手白香皇女の[[6世紀]]頃という想定年代に合わないため、真の手白香皇女陵については[[西山塚古墳]]（天理市萱生町）とする説が有力視され{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}、代わって本古墳の真の被葬者については[[卑弥呼]]（箸墓古墳被葬者か）後継者の[[台与]]とする説などが挙げられている{{R|白石}}。 == 遺跡歴 == * [[1876年]]（[[明治]]9年）、[[手白香皇女]]の陵に治定{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。 * [[1889年]]（明治22年）、陵墓として修営{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。 * [[1986年]]度（[[昭和]]61年度）、第1次調査{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}。 * [[1989年]]度（[[平成]]元年度）、墳丘外表調査（[[宮内庁書陵部]]、[[1991年]]に報告）{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。 * [[1992年|1992]]-[[1994年]]度（平成4-6年度）、第2-4次調査（天理市教育委員会、[[2000年]]に報告）{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}。 * [[2012年]]（平成24年） ** 4月9日、航空3次元測量（[[奈良県立橿原考古学研究所]]・[[アジア航測]]）{{PDFlink|[http://www.ajiko.co.jp/news/2012/hashihaka_rittaichizu.pdf 「箸墓・西殿塚古墳赤色立体地図の作成」]}}（奈良県立橿原考古学研究所・アジア航測株式会社報道発表資料、2012年）。[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG0503K_V00C12A6CR8000/ "卑弥呼の墓? 「箸墓古墳」をヘリで3D測量 橿考研など"]（日本経済新聞、2012年6月5日記事）。。 ** 8月、盗掘事件（遺構破壊は無し）とその原状復旧に伴う調査（宮内庁書陵部、[[2014年]]に報告）{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。 * [[2013年]]（平成25年）2月20日、考古・歴史学15学会代表による立ち入り調査[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG1905C_Q3A220C1CR0000/ "卑弥呼の墓?初の立ち入り調査 奈良・箸墓古墳 研究進展に期待"]（日本経済新聞、2013年2月20日記事）。。 == 墳丘 == [[画像:Tonotono-tsuka stereo.jpg|サムネイル|350px|{{center|西殿塚古墳の[[ステレオグラム|ステレオ]]空中写真（1979年）}}{{small|画像上に[[東殿塚古墳]]、下に西殿塚古墳。{{国土航空写真}}。}}]] 墳丘の規模は次の通り{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 * 墳丘長：約230メートル（文献によっては234メートル{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}、220メートル{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}、219メートル{{R|堺市}}） * 後円部 - 東側で3段築成、西側で4段築成。 ** 直径：約140メートル ** 高さ：約16メートル（東側） * 前方部 - 東側で1段築成、西側で2段築成。 ** 幅：約130メートル ** 高さ：約12メートル（東側） * 方形壇（方丘） - 1段築成。 ** 後円部：東西25.15メートル、南北26.54メートル、高さ3.00メートル{{R|2012年報道発表資料}} ** 前方部：東西12.92メートル、南北 14.43メートル、高さ1.87メートル{{R|2012年報道発表資料}} 墳丘長を219メートルとする説の場合には、全国第24位の規模に位置づけられる{{R|堺市}}。 墳丘の段築テラスは後円部・前方部を直結せず、後円部・前方部の段の違いはくびれ部で解消する{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。また、墳丘西側には西殿塚古墳特有の幅広の平坦面（エプロン）が最下段として成形されている{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。墳丘東側には陸橋状施設が後円部中央・前方部南側の2ヶ所に設けられており、いずれも隣接する[[東殿塚古墳]]に接続する{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 西殿塚古墳 {{small|なら歴史芸術文化村企画展示時に撮影。}} 西殿塚古墳 埴輪片.JPG|埴輪片
{{small|なら歴史芸術文化村企画展示時に撮影。}} == 被葬者 ==
'''『[[日本書紀]]』に基づく関係系図'''在位の記載は『日本人名大辞典』（講談社）に基づく。 {{familytree/start|style="text-align:left; font-size:100%"}} {{familytree|border=0|||||01| 01={{sup|24}} [[仁賢天皇]]
{{small|(在位:5c末)}}}} {{familytree|border=0|||||||)|.}} {{familytree|border=0|01|y|02|03| 01={{sup|26}} [[継体天皇]]
{{small|(在位:507?-531?)}}|02=[[手白香皇女|{{color|#FC4E6B|手白香皇女}}]]|03={{sup|25}} [[武烈天皇]]
{{small|(在位:5c末-6c初)}}}} {{familytree|border=0||||01|| 01={{sup|29}} [[欽明天皇]]
{{small|(在位:539?-571?)}}}} {{familytree/end}}
西殿塚古墳の実際の被葬者は明らかでないが、[[宮内庁]]では第26代[[継体天皇]]皇后の'''[[手白香皇女]]'''（たしらかのひめみこ、手白髪郎女/手白髪命）の陵に治定している{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}宮内省諸陵寮編[{{NDLDC|1237123/11}} 『陵墓要覧』]（1934年、国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション）11コマ。『陵墓地形図集成 縮小版』 宮内庁書陵部陵墓課編、[[学生社]]、2014年、p. 406。。手白香皇女の陵について、『[[日本書紀]]』・『[[古事記]]』に記載はないが、『[[延喜式]]』[[諸陵式|諸陵寮]]では遠墓の「衾田墓」として記載され、[[大和国]][[山辺郡]]の所在で、兆域は東西2町・南北2町、守戸は無く山辺道勾岡上陵（[[崇神天皇]]陵）の陵戸が兼守するとする{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。その後、[[中世]]には陵の所在に関する所伝は喪失{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。[[1876年]]（[[明治]]9年）に[[教部省]]によって西殿塚古墳が陵所と定められ、[[1889年]]（明治22年）に修営がなされている{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。 [[画像:Hashihaka-kofun zenkei.JPG|サムネイル|220px|{{center|[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）}}{{small|伝[[倭迹迹日百襲姫命]]墓。考古学的には[[ヤマト王権]]初代大王墓で[[卑弥呼]]の墓か。}}]] 以上の一方、手白香皇女の真陵に関しては、西殿塚古墳ではなく[[西山塚古墳]]（[[天理市]]萱生町）に比定する説が有力視されている{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}。この説は、西殿塚古墳の築造年代が前述のように3世紀後半頃とされる一方、西山塚古墳の年代が[[6世紀]]頃と手白香皇女の想定年代と合致する点を根拠とする{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}。一方で西殿塚古墳の真の被葬者については、[[卑弥呼]]の墓とされる[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）に後続することから[[台与]]（壹與/臺與）とする説[[白石太一郎]] 『古墳からみた倭国の形成と展開（日本歴史 私の最新講義）』 敬文舎、2013年、pp. 171-174。、[[崇神天皇]]とする説[[和田萃]] 「山辺の道をめぐって」『三輪山の古代史』 学生社、2003年。などが挙げられている。 {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%" |+ヤマト王権の
推定初期大王墓[[白石太一郎]] 『古墳からみた倭国の形成と展開（日本歴史 私の最新講義）』 敬文舎、2013年、pp. 181-186。 !代!!古墳名 |- |1||[[箸墓古墳]] |- |2||'''西殿塚古墳''' |- |3||[[桜井茶臼山古墳|外山茶臼山古墳]] |- |4||[[メスリ山古墳]] |- |5||[[行燈山古墳]] |- |6||[[渋谷向山古墳]] |} == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist|2}} == 参考文献 == * 史跡説明板（天理市教育委員会、2010年設置） * 地方自治体発行 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2000|url=http://sitereports.nabunken.go.jp/989 |title=西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|series=天理市埋蔵文化財調査報告第7集|publisher=天理市教育委員会|ref={{Harvid|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000}}}} - リンクは奈良文化財研究所「全国文化財総覧」。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2015|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=天理の古墳100|publisher=天理市教育委員会|pages=40-41|ref={{Harvid|天理の古墳100|2015}}}} * 宮内庁発行 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=1991|chapter=衾田陵の墳丘調査|title={{PDFlink|[https://shoryobu.kunaicho.go.jp/Publication/PDF/000/kiyo042a097.pdf 書陵部紀要]}}|number=42|publisher=[[宮内庁書陵部]]|ref={{Harvid|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991}}}} - リンクは宮内庁「書陵部所蔵資料目録・画像公開システム」。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2014|chapter=継体天皇皇后手白香皇女 衾田陵の原状復旧に伴う調査|title={{PDFlink|[https://shoryobu.kunaicho.go.jp/Publication/PDF/000/kiyo065b001.pdf 書陵部紀要 陵墓篇]}}|number=65|publisher=[[宮内庁書陵部]]|ref={{Harvid|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014}}}} - リンクは宮内庁「書陵部所蔵資料目録・画像公開システム」。 * 事典類 ** {{Cite book|和書|title=[[国史大辞典 (昭和時代)|国史大辞典]]|publisher=[[吉川弘文館]]}} *** {{Wikicite|reference=[[川副武胤]]「手白髪皇女」|ref={{Harvid|国史大辞典 手白髪皇女}}}}、{{Wikicite|reference=石田茂輔「衾田陵」（手白髪皇女項目内）|ref={{Harvid|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}}}。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=1981|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=奈良県の地名|sereis=[[日本歴史地名大系]]30|publisher=[[平凡社]]|isbn=4-582-49030-1|ref={{Harvid|奈良県の地名|1981}}}} ** {{Cite book|和書|author=白石太一郎|authorlink=白石太一郎|year=1989|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=[[日本古墳大辞典]]|publisher=[[東京堂出版]]|isbn=4-490-10260-7|ref={{Harvid|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}}} ** {{Cite book|和書|editor=奈良県立橿原考古学研究所|editor-link=奈良県立橿原考古学研究所|author=木下亘|year=2001|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=大和前方後円墳集成|publisher=[[学生社]]|isbn=4-311-30327-0|ref={{Harvid|大和前方後円墳集成|2001}}}} == 関連項目 == {{Commonscat|Nishitonozuka Kofun}} * [[大和古墳群]] * [[手白香皇女]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html 西殿塚古墳] - {{日本の古墳 |名称 = 西殿塚古墳 |画像 = [[画像:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, zenkei.jpg|280px]]
墳丘（右に前方部、左奥に後円部） |所属 = [[大和古墳群]]（中山支群） |所在地 = [[奈良県]][[天理市]]中山町字西殿塚{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}} |緯度度 = 34|緯度分 = 34|緯度秒 = 6.22 |経度度 =135|経度分 = 51|経度秒 = 4.26 |ISO = JP-29 |形状 = [[前方後円墳]] |規模 = 墳丘長230[[メートル|m]]
高さ約16m（後円部） |築造時期 = [[3世紀]]後半-末 |埋葬施設 = 不明 |被葬者 = （[[宮内庁]]治定）[[手白香皇女]]
（一説）[[台与|倭王台与]]
（一説）第10代[[崇神天皇]] |出土品 = [[特殊器台・特殊壺|宮山型特殊器台・特殊壺・都月型特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪]]
[[円筒埴輪|普通円筒埴輪]] |陵墓 = [[宮内庁]]治定「衾田陵」 |特記事項 = 全国第24位の規模
（墳丘長219mとする場合）[https://www.city.sakai.lg.jp/kanko/rekishi/dkofun/ranking/zenkoku.html 古墳大きさランキング（日本全国版）]（堺市ホームページ、2018年5月13日更新版）。
[[箸墓古墳]]に次ぐ大王墓か |地図 = Japan Nara |ラベル = 西殿塚古墳 |ラベル位置 = top |アイコン = 前方後円墳-南 }} [[画像:Nishitonotsuka Kofun, haisho.jpg|サムネイル|250px|{{center|[[手白香皇女]]衾田陵 拝所}}]] '''西殿塚古墳'''（にしとのづかこふん{{R|説明板}}）は、[[奈良県]][[天理市]]中山町にある[[古墳]]。形状は[[前方後円墳]]。[[大和古墳群]]（中山支群）を構成する古墳の1つ。 実際の被葬者は明らかでないが、[[宮内庁]]により「'''衾田陵'''（ふすまだのみささぎ）」として第26代[[継体天皇]]皇后の[[手白香皇女]]の陵に治定されている。 [[3世紀]]後半（[[古墳時代]]前期前半）頃の築造と推定され、古墳時代最初期の[[箸墓古墳]]に後続する大王墓とする説で知られる。 == 概要 == [[奈良盆地]]東縁の丘陵上に築造された巨大前方後円墳である。東側には隣接して[[東殿塚古墳]]があり、2基は[[大和古墳群]]のうちでは最高所にあって盆地全域を眺望する史跡説明板。{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。墳丘は良好に遺存する{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。現在は[[宮内庁]]治定の皇后陵として同庁の管理下にあり、[[1989年]]度（[[平成]]元年度）に[[宮内庁書陵部]]による墳丘外表調査が実施されたほか{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}、[[1992年|1992]]-[[1994年]]度（平成4-6年度）に天理市教育委員会による墳丘周辺部の調査{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}、[[2012年]]度（平成24年度）に学会立ち入り調査などが実施されている{{R|2013年調査}}。 墳形は前方後円形で前方部を南方に向けるが、東西方向の傾斜地（高位は東側）に直角に築造されているため左右非対称形をとる{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}。墳丘は後円部で東側3段築成・西側4段築成、前方部で東側1段築成・西側2段築成{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。墳丘長は約230[[メートル]]を測るが、これは大和古墳群では最大規模になる。墳丘外表には[[葺石]]が認められるほか{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}、[[特殊器台・特殊壺|特殊器台形土器・特殊器台形埴輪・特殊壺形埴輪]]（以上墳丘部）、有段口縁の[[円筒埴輪]]などの初期埴輪（墳丘周辺部）等が出土している{{R|説明板}}。埋葬施設は明らかでないが、墳丘上では後円部・前方部それぞれに方形壇（方丘）が認められている{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 築造時期は、[[古墳時代]]前期前半の[[3世紀]]後半頃と推定される{{R|説明板}}[http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html 西殿塚古墳]（天理市ホームページ）。。[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）に後続する[[ヤマト王権]]の大王墓と目され{{R|白石}}、隣接する東殿塚古墳とでは西殿塚古墳を先とする連続的な築造とされる{{R|説明板}}。被葬者は明らかでないが、現在は宮内庁により[[手白香皇女]]（第26代[[継体天皇]][[皇后]]）の陵に治定される{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。ただし築造年代は手白香皇女の[[6世紀]]頃という想定年代に合わないため、真の手白香皇女陵については[[西山塚古墳]]（天理市萱生町）とする説が有力視され{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}、代わって本古墳の真の被葬者については[[卑弥呼]]（箸墓古墳被葬者か）後継者の[[台与]]とする説などが挙げられている{{R|白石}}。 == 遺跡歴 == * [[1876年]]（[[明治]]9年）、[[手白香皇女]]の陵に治定{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。 * [[1889年]]（明治22年）、陵墓として修営{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。 * [[1986年]]度（[[昭和]]61年度）、第1次調査{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}。 * [[1989年]]度（[[平成]]元年度）、墳丘外表調査（[[宮内庁書陵部]]、[[1991年]]に報告）{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。 * [[1992年|1992]]-[[1994年]]度（平成4-6年度）、第2-4次調査（天理市教育委員会、[[2000年]]に報告）{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=1-4}}。 * [[2012年]]（平成24年） ** 4月9日、航空3次元測量（[[奈良県立橿原考古学研究所]]・[[アジア航測]]）{{PDFlink|[http://www.ajiko.co.jp/news/2012/hashihaka_rittaichizu.pdf 「箸墓・西殿塚古墳赤色立体地図の作成」]}}（奈良県立橿原考古学研究所・アジア航測株式会社報道発表資料、2012年）。[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG0503K_V00C12A6CR8000/ "卑弥呼の墓? 「箸墓古墳」をヘリで3D測量 橿考研など"]（日本経済新聞、2012年6月5日記事）。。 ** 8月、盗掘事件（遺構破壊は無し）とその原状復旧に伴う調査（宮内庁書陵部、[[2014年]]に報告）{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}。 * [[2013年]]（平成25年）2月20日、考古・歴史学15学会代表による立ち入り調査[https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXNASDG1905C_Q3A220C1CR0000/ "卑弥呼の墓?初の立ち入り調査 奈良・箸墓古墳 研究進展に期待"]（日本経済新聞、2013年2月20日記事）。。 == 墳丘 == [[画像:Tonotono-tsuka stereo.jpg|サムネイル|350px|{{center|西殿塚古墳の[[ステレオグラム|ステレオ]]空中写真（1979年）}}{{small|画像上に[[東殿塚古墳]]、下に西殿塚古墳。{{国土航空写真}}。}}]] 墳丘の規模は次の通り{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 * 墳丘長：約230メートル（文献によっては234メートル{{Sfn|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}、220メートル{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014|pp=108-112}}、219メートル{{R|堺市}}） * 後円部 - 東側で3段築成、西側で4段築成。 ** 直径：約140メートル ** 高さ：約16メートル（東側） * 前方部 - 東側で1段築成、西側で2段築成。 ** 幅：約130メートル ** 高さ：約12メートル（東側） * 方形壇（方丘） - 1段築成。 ** 後円部：東西25.15メートル、南北26.54メートル、高さ3.00メートル{{R|2012年報道発表資料}} ** 前方部：東西12.92メートル、南北 14.43メートル、高さ1.87メートル{{R|2012年報道発表資料}} 墳丘長を219メートルとする説の場合には、全国第24位の規模に位置づけられる{{R|堺市}}。 墳丘の段築テラスは後円部・前方部を直結せず、後円部・前方部の段の違いはくびれ部で解消する{{Sfn|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991|pp=100-111}}。また、墳丘西側には西殿塚古墳特有の幅広の平坦面（エプロン）が最下段として成形されている{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。墳丘東側には陸橋状施設が後円部中央・前方部南側の2ヶ所に設けられており、いずれも隣接する[[東殿塚古墳]]に接続する{{Sfn|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000|pp=5-7}}。 西殿塚古墳 円筒埴輪.JPG|円筒埴輪
{{small|なら歴史芸術文化村企画展示時に撮影。}} 西殿塚古墳 埴輪片.JPG|埴輪片
{{small|なら歴史芸術文化村企画展示時に撮影。}} == 被葬者 ==
'''『[[日本書紀]]』に基づく関係系図'''在位の記載は『日本人名大辞典』（講談社）に基づく。 {{familytree/start|style="text-align:left; font-size:100%"}} {{familytree|border=0|||||01| 01={{sup|24}} [[仁賢天皇]]
{{small|(在位:5c末)}}}} {{familytree|border=0|||||||)|.}} {{familytree|border=0|01|y|02|03| 01={{sup|26}} [[継体天皇]]
{{small|(在位:507?-531?)}}|02=[[手白香皇女|{{color|#FC4E6B|手白香皇女}}]]|03={{sup|25}} [[武烈天皇]]
{{small|(在位:5c末-6c初)}}}} {{familytree|border=0||||01|| 01={{sup|29}} [[欽明天皇]]
{{small|(在位:539?-571?)}}}} {{familytree/end}}
西殿塚古墳の実際の被葬者は明らかでないが、[[宮内庁]]では第26代[[継体天皇]]皇后の'''[[手白香皇女]]'''（たしらかのひめみこ、手白髪郎女/手白髪命）の陵に治定している{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}宮内省諸陵寮編[{{NDLDC|1237123/11}} 『陵墓要覧』]（1934年、国立国会図書館デジタルコレクション）11コマ。『陵墓地形図集成 縮小版』 宮内庁書陵部陵墓課編、[[学生社]]、2014年、p. 406。。手白香皇女の陵について、『[[日本書紀]]』・『[[古事記]]』に記載はないが、『[[延喜式]]』[[諸陵式|諸陵寮]]では遠墓の「衾田墓」として記載され、[[大和国]][[山辺郡]]の所在で、兆域は東西2町・南北2町、守戸は無く山辺道勾岡上陵（[[崇神天皇]]陵）の陵戸が兼守するとする{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。その後、[[中世]]には陵の所在に関する所伝は喪失{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。[[1876年]]（[[明治]]9年）に[[教部省]]によって西殿塚古墳が陵所と定められ、[[1889年]]（明治22年）に修営がなされている{{Sfn|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}。 [[画像:Hashihaka-kofun zenkei.JPG|サムネイル|220px|{{center|[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）}}{{small|伝[[倭迹迹日百襲姫命]]墓。考古学的には[[ヤマト王権]]初代大王墓で[[卑弥呼]]の墓か。}}]] 以上の一方、手白香皇女の真陵に関しては、西殿塚古墳ではなく[[西山塚古墳]]（[[天理市]]萱生町）に比定する説が有力視されている{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}。この説は、西殿塚古墳の築造年代が前述のように3世紀後半頃とされる一方、西山塚古墳の年代が[[6世紀]]頃と手白香皇女の想定年代と合致する点を根拠とする{{Sfn|天理の古墳100|2015|p=55}}。一方で西殿塚古墳の真の被葬者については、[[卑弥呼]]の墓とされる[[箸墓古墳]]（[[桜井市]]箸中）に後続することから[[台与]]（壹與/臺與）とする説[[白石太一郎]] 『古墳からみた倭国の形成と展開（日本歴史 私の最新講義）』 敬文舎、2013年、pp. 171-174。、[[崇神天皇]]とする説[[和田萃]] 「山辺の道をめぐって」『三輪山の古代史』 学生社、2003年。などが挙げられている。 {| class="wikitable" style="background:#ffffff;text-align:center;font-size:85%" |+ヤマト王権の
推定初期大王墓[[白石太一郎]] 『古墳からみた倭国の形成と展開（日本歴史 私の最新講義）』 敬文舎、2013年、pp. 181-186。 !代!!古墳名 |- |1||[[箸墓古墳]] |- |2||'''西殿塚古墳''' |- |3||[[桜井茶臼山古墳|外山茶臼山古墳]] |- |4||[[メスリ山古墳]] |- |5||[[行燈山古墳]] |- |6||[[渋谷向山古墳]] |} == 脚注 == {{脚注ヘルプ}} {{reflist|2}} == 参考文献 == * 史跡説明板（天理市教育委員会、2010年設置） * 地方自治体発行 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2000|url=http://sitereports.nabunken.go.jp/989 |title=西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|series=天理市埋蔵文化財調査報告第7集|publisher=天理市教育委員会|ref={{Harvid|西殿塚古墳・東殿塚古墳|2000}}}} - リンクは奈良文化財研究所「全国文化財総覧」。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2015|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=天理の古墳100|publisher=天理市教育委員会|pages=40-41|ref={{Harvid|天理の古墳100|2015}}}} * 宮内庁発行 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=1991|chapter=衾田陵の墳丘調査|title={{PDFlink|[https://shoryobu.kunaicho.go.jp/Publication/PDF/000/kiyo042a097.pdf 書陵部紀要]}}|number=42|publisher=[[宮内庁書陵部]]|ref={{Harvid|書陵部紀要 第42号|1991}}}} - リンクは宮内庁「書陵部所蔵資料目録・画像公開システム」。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=2014|chapter=継体天皇皇后手白香皇女 衾田陵の原状復旧に伴う調査|title={{PDFlink|[https://shoryobu.kunaicho.go.jp/Publication/PDF/000/kiyo065b001.pdf 書陵部紀要 陵墓篇]}}|number=65|publisher=[[宮内庁書陵部]]|ref={{Harvid|書陵部紀要 陵墓篇 第65号|2014}}}} - リンクは宮内庁「書陵部所蔵資料目録・画像公開システム」。 * 事典類 ** {{Cite book|和書|title=[[国史大辞典 (昭和時代)|国史大辞典]]|publisher=[[吉川弘文館]]}} *** {{Wikicite|reference=[[川副武胤]]「手白髪皇女」|ref={{Harvid|国史大辞典 手白髪皇女}}}}、{{Wikicite|reference=石田茂輔「衾田陵」（手白髪皇女項目内）|ref={{Harvid|国史大辞典 衾田陵}}}}。 ** {{Cite book|和書|year=1981|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=奈良県の地名|sereis=[[日本歴史地名大系]]30|publisher=[[平凡社]]|isbn=4-582-49030-1|ref={{Harvid|奈良県の地名|1981}}}} ** {{Cite book|和書|author=白石太一郎|authorlink=白石太一郎|year=1989|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=[[日本古墳大辞典]]|publisher=[[東京堂出版]]|isbn=4-490-10260-7|ref={{Harvid|日本古墳大辞典|1989}}}} ** {{Cite book|和書|editor=奈良県立橿原考古学研究所|editor-link=奈良県立橿原考古学研究所|author=木下亘|year=2001|chapter=西殿塚古墳|title=大和前方後円墳集成|publisher=[[学生社]]|isbn=4-311-30327-0|ref={{Harvid|大和前方後円墳集成|2001}}}} == 関連項目 == {{Commonscat|Nishitonozuka Kofun}} * [[大和古墳群]] * [[手白香皇女]] == 外部リンク == * [http://www.city.tenri.nara.jp/miryoku/tenrinomiryoku1/kofun/1445323092951.html 西殿塚古墳] -
